issue: Whitespace / case inconsistency in category labels
action: Trimmed and collapsed whitespace; labels left in source casing
rationale: Audit found labels already consistent (0 changes). Step retained so the pipeline is repeatable on new extracts.

issue: No grouping of channels; organic CAC would show as 0 (misleading)
action: Added analyst-defined channel_group and is_paid; organic left with no CAC in downstream tables
rationale: Organic activity has hidden costs (content, SEO, brand) that the data does not record, so CAC=0 is not 'free acquisition'.

action: Set to NULL when no deposit was made
rationale: A zero would pull down averages and medians; NULL makes the 'not funded' state explicit.

issue: Completion flags include events dated after the 2026-10-31 snapshot (future information)
action: Added *_asof flags and *_date_asof dates counting only events on/before snapshot; original columns retained untouched
rationale: Prevents the Oct-2026 cohort from showing conversion that had not yet happened (first-trade 40.0% on flags vs 8.4% as-of).

issue: No explicit eligibility for conversion or inactivity metrics
action: Added maturity and eligibility columns (mature = registered before 2026-10; eligible_30d = tenure>=31 d; eligible_90d = tenure>=91 d)
rationale: Separates 'not yet eligible' from 'genuinely inactive'. 21 users with tenure=30 d are inconsistent in the source flag and are treated as not yet eligible.

issue: last_active_date earlier than the user's own KYC/bank/deposit/trade date
action: last_active_date_adj = max(last_active_date, latest as-of funnel event); days_inactive_adj recomputed from it
rationale: A user cannot be last active before completing an action; the funnel event is itself proof of activity. Original columns kept.

issue: Churn proxies computed on all users incl. those too new to be inactive; 90-day proxy truncated at 120 days
action: Re-derived from days_inactive_adj with explicit eligibility; ineligible users get NULL and status 'not_yet_eligible'. Called 'inactive proxy', never 'churn'
rationale: Genuine churn (closure, asset transfer-out, zero balance) is not observable in this dataset.

issue: Engagement fields exist only at user-month grain
action: Aggregated Monthly_Activity to user level; retention flags are NULL where the window is not yet observable (e.g. M3 needs registration <= 2026-07)
rationale: Retention is recalculated from source events (monthly activity), not from the supplied snapshot flags.

action: Added row-level flags; no rows deleted or values overwritten
rationale: No ground truth identifies which table is wrong, so contradictions are exposed, not silently resolved.

action: Converted to 0/1 int8 in all output files
rationale: Consistent typing for SQL, Excel and Power BI.

action: All dates written as ISO yyyy-mm-dd; months as yyyy-mm

issue: Source rows contradict the Users funnel flags
action: Rows kept. Added consistency, outlier and derived-measure columns
rationale: Monthly_Activity is the source of truth for engagement; Users for funnel. Rows are neither deleted nor 'fixed' because the true value is unknown.

issue: Resolution time / CSAT exist only for resolved tickets (survivorship); no backlog ageing; no link between ticket and funnel stage
action: Added resolved/unresolved flags, ageing buckets and a stage-pending flag (ticket created before the related funnel event, or event never reached)
rationale: Lets Phase 3 report resolved-only averages alongside the unresolved backlog and test the 'stuck at stage' hypothesis.
